segments.headline: SAME AGENT. TWO PAYBACKS.
segments.spoken: The same AI invoice agent pays back in three and a half months, or nearly ten. What changed? The exception rate.

segments.headline: START WITH REAL COSTS
segments.spoken: Here is a hypothetical workflow: six thousand invoices monthly, eighteen thousand dollars of manual processing cost, and thirty thousand dollars to implement.

segments.headline: MORE EXCEPTIONS. SLOWER PAYBACK.
segments.body: 60% completed without repair. $3,100 monthly economic benefit.
segments.spoken: At sixty percent straight-through completion, the model leaves thirty-one hundred dollars in monthly economic benefit. Payback takes nine point seven months.

segments.headline: FEWER EXCEPTIONS. FASTER PAYBACK.
segments.body: 90% completed without repair. $8,500 monthly economic benefit.
segments.spoken: At ninety percent completion, the model shows eighty-five hundred dollars per month. Payback falls to three point five months.

segments.headline: SAME COST ASSUMPTIONS
segments.body: Review, software, support and reserve held fixed. Illustrative, not cash savings.
segments.spoken: Review, software, support, and risk-reserve assumptions stay fixed. These are projected economic benefits, not verified cash savings.

segments.headline: TEST BEFORE YOU BUY
segments.body: Measure correct straight-through completions and exception handling.
segments.spoken: Before buying an agent, measure straight-through completion and time the exceptions. Follow for practical AI business systems.
